title: Act: Create buildSpriteSheet in the frontend lib
summary: Add game/frontend/src/lib/spriteSheet.ts with the pure buildSpriteSheet function
description: Create the pure function that lays equal-size RGBA frames side by side into one sheet and returns size and frame metadata.
acceptance_criteria: buildSpriteSheet(frames) returns width = frameWidth*frameCount and height = frameHeight
Empty input or mismatched frame sizes throw
technical_constraints: Pure, deterministic, does not mutate input frames
Shared palette colours pass through unchanged
definition_of_done: File exists, exports buildSpriteSheet and SpriteSheet, and tsc --noEmit accepts it

steps.action: Create the file exporting interface SpriteFrame {width:number;height:number;data:Uint8ClampedArray} and interface SpriteSheet extends SpriteFrame with frameWidth, frameHeight and frameCount numbers.
steps.code:
export interface SpriteFrame { width: number; height: number; data: Uint8ClampedArray; }
export interface SpriteSheet extends SpriteFrame { frameWidth: number; frameHeight: number; frameCount: number; }

steps.action: Export buildSpriteSheet(frames: readonly SpriteFrame[]): SpriteSheet. Throw when frames is empty or any frame width/height differs from frames[0]. Allocate data of size frameWidth*frameCount*frameHeight*4 and, for each frame i and row y, copy frame.data.subarray(y*fw*4,(y+1)*fw*4) to offset (y*sheetWidth + i*fw)*4 using data.set.
steps.expected: Frames are laid out left to right with metadata
